issues.description: fieldsWriter throws UnsupportedOperationException at use-time instead of failing at construction or in the type system.
issues.detail: All three reviewers flag this: the read-only contract is enforced by a runtime throw deep in the write path, while public no-arg constructors and SPI registration still hand out apparently-usable instances. Express read-only as a ReadOnlyKnnVectorsFormat supertype, or fail in the constructor with a pointer to Lucene104. Failing at first index flush wastes debugging time and violates LSP.

issues.description: Dead numMergeWorkers/mergeExec constructor parameters retained after removal of write path.
issues.detail: Lucene99HnswScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat still accepts and validates numMergeWorkers and ExecutorService, then discards them. The signature lies about the postcondition. Either drop the parameters or explicitly document them as ignored source-compat shims on a read-only format.

issues.description: DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT duplicated rather than sourced from a single on-disk-format spec.
issues.detail: The constant previously imported from Lucene99FlatVectorsFormat is now redeclared in Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat with no invariant linking the two values. Two sources of truth for an on-disk parameter invites silent drift. Either keep importing the canonical value or move it into a shared spec class in backward_codecs.

issues.description: Protected fields on public abstract OffHeapQuantizedByteVectorValues silently demoted to package-private.
issues.detail: The class remains public abstract but its previously protected fields are now package-private, breaking any external subclass without explanation. Either seal/finalize the class to close the hierarchy, or restore the protected contract deliberately. The current half-step leaves a public ADT with no usable extension surface.

issues.description: Test-only RW subclasses reach into package-private internals to restore write capability.
issues.detail: Lucene99RWScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat overrides fieldsWriter by relying on package-private rawVectorFormat, flatVectorScorer, confidenceInterval, bits, compress. This is inheritance-for-reuse that re-weakens the read-only contract and creates an undeclared coupling. Prefer composition via a protected createWriter() hook on the production class.

issues.description: Public API symbols (NAME, QUANTIZED_VECTOR_COMPONENT, calculateDefaultConfidenceInterval) demoted without a deprecation cycle.
issues.detail: Previously public constants and methods on a released format are demoted to package-private in the same release that relocates the class. External callers referencing them by name break at link time with no deprecation warning. Leave the symbols public-and-deprecated for one release before removal, and split the diff into move / visibility / write-disable patches.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the relocation of the Lucene99 scalar-quantized formats into backward_codecs is the right direction but the contract work is incomplete. The dominant complaint, raised by all three reviewers, is that read-only enforcement lives in a runtime UnsupportedOperationException rather than in the type system or constructor, while SPI still hands out apparently-writable instances. Secondary issues cluster around half-finished refactors: dead constructor parameters, a duplicated on-disk constant, silently narrowed visibility on a public abstract class, and test subclasses that reach across package-private boundaries to override the disabled writer. The patch should be split into pure move, visibility/deprecation, and write-disable commits before landing.
